title: valeriana hidalgoana
intro: Valeriana hidalgoana, commonly known as the Mexican valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as improved sleep quality, reduced anxiety, and relief from stress. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana hidalgoana include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valerenic acids, valeranone, and valepotriates. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to promote relaxation, reduce muscle spasms, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness.
